historicalPathsAreProvenanceOnly: Absolute paths inside original records identify source runs; the viewer uses only packaged relative file references.

evidence.method: Triangle inequality over original native arm/hand tree; hinge pivot offsets twice, bounded slides and complete compiled geom AABBs. Conservative for every native arm posture.

transform.formula: world = origin + Rz(exact phi) * (source base G3 + delta G3)

method.floor: Fresh evaluation of original source-USD floor triangles at centre plus 32 half-radius and 32 full-radius samples; 65 independent sample positions per exact transformed base
method.wall: Original source-USD wall/exterior triangles intersecting Z [-0.01,0.4] m; conservative XY triangle distance minus the full 0.25 m circular radius
method.furniture: Continuous circle vs original source-geometry world AABBs; bounds from source export, independently verified against original USD to 3.56e-15 m; include objects with min Z < 0.4 m and max Z > 0.03 m

evidence.coordinates: Exact source G3 base plus frozen delta and exact handoff phi; no pi approximation.
